3652-4247-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Ornithopter is starting in your graveyard.
3652-4247-5006-8170.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Ornithopter spell. Then, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Ornithopter, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

728-1202-3249-4474.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1202-3249-4474.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

222-527-1849-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1849-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-1849-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6968-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6968-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-6798-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
978-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1824-2530-3497-7360.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-3497-7360.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
1824-2530-3497-7360.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
God-Pharaoh's Faithful triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

2301-5147-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2301-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Abzan Ascendancy and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2301-5686-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2301-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Abzan Ascendancy and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6968-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
3259-6968-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6968-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
3259-6968-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3292-3892-7175.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3892-7175.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

2033-3713-5078-5741.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

679-2894-3674-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
679-2894-3674-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Necroplasm. Then, the draw will be replaced by Necroplasm's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Necroplasm from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-2700-2744-4499-6627.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Arcbound Shikari trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1669-1850-5967.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1669-1850-5967.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1116-3240-4699-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-4699-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Overgrowth Elemental and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Overgrowth Elemental and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

2730-5256-6553.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2730-5256-6553.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

5231-6243-6288.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Infernal Vessel, adding {R}.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Infernal Vessel, adding {R}.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel in additional to its other types.
Repeat.

2558-5330-5687-5688.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Judith, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

116-745-2569.notablePrerequisites:
Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry do not have summoning sickness.
116-745-2569.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry.
Activate Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry by tapping it.
When Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

222-629-2438-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-629-2438-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Gruff Triplets and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Gruff Triplets die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Gruff Triplets' power on each creature you control named Gruff Triplets.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Gruff Triplets from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Slimefoot and Squue and Gruff Triplets' second ability triggers.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets trigger, creating two token copes of it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a Gruff Triplets token.
When the Gruff Triplets token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

532-2430-3415-5218.description:
Cast Petals of Insight by discarding Voidwielder.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Voidwielder and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Cast Voidwielder from exile by discarding Petals of Insight.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Petals of Insight and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Voidwielder enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Petals of Insight from exile by discarding Voidwielder.
Repeat from step 2.

1512-2277-4050-4275.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Wizards.
1512-2277-4050-4275.description:
Activate Supreme Inquisitor by tapping it, Stonybrook Schoolmaster, and any other three Wizards you control.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature token.
Resolve the Supreme Inquisitor ability, causing you to search a player's library for five cards and exile them.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk Wizard, adding one mana of any color.
When the Merfolk Wizard dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolks and Wizards on the battlefield.
Repeat.

232-3398-3851.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Priest of Urabrask.
Priest of Urabrask does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Priest of Urabrask and Hellkite Charger.
232-3398-3851.description:
Declare Priest of Urabrask as an attacker.
Hellkite Charger and Priest of Urabrask' myriad ability trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, creating at least three token copies of it that are tapped and attacking.
The Priest of Urabrask tokens enter the battlefield, adding at least nine {R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Blade of Selves triggers, exiling the Priest of Urabrask tokens.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-1003-2626-4986.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phyrexian Walker enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.
